subject: Publicity permission for strategic concession — Novacorp deal
messages:
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Publicity permission for strategic concession — Novacorp deal

Alexandra,

Thanks again for the time today — we appreciated the deep dive on Novacorp's rollout priorities. I wanted to follow up with a concise ask that would let us offer a commercial concession to help close this quarter.

Proposal (simple):
- Redwood provides a one-time commercial credit equal to 12% of first-year invoice (applied on first invoice).
- In exchange, Novacorp permits Redwood to:
  * Use Novacorp logo in our customer list (web + one slide)
  * Publish a short (1–2 sentence) customer quote from Alexandra or the appointed product lead
  * Co-author a brief success blurb (350 words max) to be reviewed by Novacorp before publishing

We can attach a short publicity terms doc for legal to review — attached is our standard starter (redwood-publicity-terms-v1.pdf). If the ask is acceptable at a high level, can you confirm who at Novacorp would sign off on the quote and logo (marketing, PR, or legal)? Also, please flag any constraints (embargo windows, special attribution language, logo lockup rules).

If a credit higher than 12% is needed to accelerate signing this month, say the number and we can route for quick exec approval.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-publicity-terms-v1.pdf, deal-summary-RDW-2024-084.xlsx

Date: Mon, 21 Apr 2025 11:08:00 -0700
From: Alexandra Ruiz <aruiz@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novacorp.com
Subject: Re: Publicity permission for strategic concession — Novacorp deal

Soojin,

Thanks for the clear note. High-level Novacorp is open to a short public quote + logo on your site and the 350-word blurb, provided the following:
- Logo usage limited to website and one slide; we will supply the official lockup.
- Quote must be reviewed and can be edited for accuracy by our comms team (we prefer to approve the final text).
- No use in paid ads or partner co-marketing without separate approval.

Legal has attached a quick redline request (I copied legal@novacorp.com) but this is not expected to be heavy — they want an explicit clause limiting usage and a 30-day takedown provision.

On the commercial side: procurement usually needs a 15% concession to shift preferred vendor status into the budget this quarter. If Redwood can move to 15% on year-one billings, we can expedite the PO and procurement sign-off.

Would Marissa or Ben be able to confirm internally whether that increment is feasible? If yes, we can route the publicity terms to our legal team this afternoon.

Best,
Alexandra Ruiz
VP, Cloud Architecture | Novacorp
aruiz@novacorp.com

Attachments: novacorp-legal-quick-redlines.pdf, novacorp-logo-guidelines.pdf

Date: Mon, 21 Apr 2025 12:02:00 -0700
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Subject: Fwd: Publicity permission for strategic concession — Novacorp deal

Marissa — forwarding Alexandra's reply. Procurement is asking for a 15% concession to lock this in this quarter. Current desk guidance caps standard discounts at 10% without exec sign-off.

Why I recommend approving 15%:
- Novacorp is a high-visibility reference target for our vertical (financial services platform).
- They have a large footprint and several line-of-business teams evaluating next phase — reference + logo will accelerate pipeline across the segment.
- This is a one-time credit applied to first-year invoice; our ARR impact is manageable and the customer LTV upside looks strong.

If you agree, I can escalate to Vivek for a rapid OK. Also attaching the deal summary for context.

—Ben

Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:30:00 -0700
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Fwd: Publicity permission for strategic concession — Novacorp deal

Team — after a quick review of the deal summary and the expected pipeline benefit, I approve a one-time 15% commercial credit on first-year invoice for Novacorp (deal RDW-2024-084) on the following conditions:

1) Publicity terms are limited to: website logo, one-slide logo use, and a 1–2 sentence quote + the 350-word approved blurb. No paid ad usage or implied exclusivity.
2) Novacorp must provide finalized logo lockup and confirm the named quote author; Redwood legal to get final sign-off on the copy within 48 hours of delivery.
3) Marketing collateral must include the agreed-upon attribution language and a link to Novacorp's privacy policy where required.
4) Finance to record the concession as a one-time commercial credit tied to deal RDW-2024-084 and flag for revenue recognition impact.

Ben/Marissa: please confirm you will (a) insert the one-time credit in the SOW/amendment, (b) route to Finance for booking, and (c) upload the final publicity terms to the deal record. I want this closed this week.

Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
